name: selfsign
description: Self-hosted web app to fill and visually sign PDFs entirely in the browser.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @selfsign/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @selfsign/server" "npm run dev -w @selfsign/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @selfsign/shared && npm run build -w @selfsign/server && npm run build -w @selfsign/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @selfsign/shared && npm test -w @selfsign/server && npm test -w @selfsign/web
